artifact.name: Niyama two-regime linear cost predictor
artifact.filter: Exclude only completed steps with y >1s from artifact fit and filtered metrics
artifact.boundary_adaptation: Pinned code literally uses >513 for upper bin; intended 513+ is implemented as >512 here. Count exact-total-513 rows explicitly.

estimator.method: Centered/scaled column-pivoted Householder QR, rank errors retained, no regularization/clipping
estimator.collinearity: Artifact total=P+D. Setting total coefficient to zero and adding its coefficient to both P and D preserves every prediction; these four columns span the same linear predictor space.
estimator.rank_note: Intercept plus four features; rank below four after centering is unsupported.

cost_label: Host engine.step completion: end_s-start_s, including scheduler/output handling; not GPU-only time or full-service effect

feature_definition.Cdecode: Sum(computed_start+1) over actual scheduled requests with decode_tokens>0
feature_definition.Cprefill: Sum(computed_start) over actual scheduled requests with prefill_tokens>0

split_note: Five frozen complete training runs and their five reverse-order held-out runs; requests or steps within a run are not independent validation repeats.

monotonicity_diagnostic.scope: Hold actual validation-step D and executed-request contexts constant; substitute legal total tiers. Predictor-domain check only, not scheduler-state replay or measured action outcomes. Both tier lists checked without claiming either was active.

interpretation: Transfer diagnostic only. Error statistics neither prove online decision utility nor provide an SLO guarantee. No thresholds or safety margins searched.
